label: Rigid initial profile denies the single bearer-omission edge
paraphrase: For every typed history profile with M as its frame, every E frame, world a and bearer b: if the profile is rigid at a and b is initial at a, then NO E-successor of a that lacks b is an M-successor of a (the single bearer-omission edge fails). In the four-history structural surrogate, the qualitative profile has that edge (via history 2) while failing restricted inclusion on all bearer omissions (via history 3), and the rigid profile lacks the edge. The surrogate separation presupposes bearer-distinct qualitative duplicates (OPEN). Analyst formulation, attribution deferred.
